I replied in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That comes from Dana in #north-team on 2025-08-20, the day after it was signed. She first posted 180 seats, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

I can't see the amendment itself, so I couldn't check the number against the signed copy. Dana sent that copy to June Osei-Lark, so June could confirm it before your 10:00 if you want to be sure.
